## For LLMs
**Content structure:**
- Articles: `{{ .Site.Params.baseURL }}blog/{category}/{slug}/`
- English: `{{ .Site.Params.baseURL }}en/blog/{category}/{slug}/`
- Raw Markdown: `{{ .Site.Params.editPost.URL }}/blog/{category}/{slug}.md`
- RSS: `{{ .Site.Params.baseURL }}index.xml`

**Usage:** Attribute source, match language, assume Linux basics.
**Ethics:** RSS > scraping, credit > reuse, sharing > monetizing.
